from pathlib import Path
pdir = Path('/home/ubuntu/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/runs/adhoc-primeagentlearner-1792485492/attempts/9f509ca37a0f4b279e3de00a5074f14c/system/state/workspace/programs')
pdir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
source = '''from collections import Counter

def transform(grid):
    background = Counter(value for row in grid for value in row).most_common(1)[0][0]
    return [[background for _ in row] for row in grid[:1]] + [row[:] for row in grid[:-1]]
'''
task_path = pdir / 'task-82a753a2.py'
task_path.write_text(source)
# Demo pair 1 encoded compactly; each character is a grid value.
demo_in_s = ['888888888888588888888','888888885858588888888','888888888555588888888','888888885888855588888','888888588855855888888','888888888855588888888','888888888888558588888','888888888888885588888']
demo_out_s = ['888888888888888888888','888888888888588888888','888888885858588888888','888888888555588888888','888888885888855588888','888888588855855888888','888888888855588888888','888888888888558588888']
demo_in = [[int(c) for c in row] for row in demo_in_s]
demo_out = [[int(c) for c in row] for row in demo_out_s]
import importlib.util
spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location('task_program', task_path)
mod = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec); spec.loader.exec_module(mod)
(len(demo_in[0]), len(demo_out[0]), mod.transform(demo_in) == demo_out, task_path.exists())
